welcome:
Welcome to the Podman CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore rootless containers, pods, and systemd integration.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: Create a new pod named 'webapp' that exposes port 8080 on the host.
Add an nginx container to the pod to serve as the frontend.
steps.hint: Try: podman run -d --pod webapp --name web nginx:alpine

steps.instruction: Add a redis container to the same pod for caching (containers in a pod share localhost).
steps.hint: Try: podman run -d --pod webapp --name cache redis:7-alpine

steps.instruction: List all pods to verify 'webapp' is running with its containers.
Inspect the pod to see its network configuration and container IDs.
Check that both containers inside the pod are healthy.
Stop the entire pod (all containers stop together).
Remove the pod and all its containers in one command.
Build a container image from the Containerfile in the current directory, tagging it for your registry.
List local images to confirm the build succeeded.
Tag the image with a 'latest' alias for convenience.
Log in to the container registry before pushing.
Push the versioned image to the registry.
Run the image locally to verify it works before generating a service.
Generate a systemd unit file so the container starts on boot (rootless, user service).
Clean up: stop and remove the test container.
steps.expect: podman stop myapp && podman rm myapp
steps.hint: Try: podman stop myapp && podman rm myapp

commands.help:
Available commands:
  podman ps                      — List running containers
  podman ps -a                   — List all containers (including stopped)
  podman images                  — List local images
  podman run                     — Create and start a container
  podman build                   — Build image from Containerfile
  podman pull                    — Pull image from registry
  podman push                    — Push image to registry
  podman tag                     — Add tag to an image
  podman logs                    — View container logs
  podman inspect                 — Show container/image/pod details
  podman exec                    — Execute command in running container
  podman stop/start/rm           — Container lifecycle
  podman rmi                     — Remove image
  podman pod create/list/rm      — Pod management
  podman generate systemd        — Generate systemd unit files
  podman generate kube           — Generate Kubernetes YAML
  podman play kube               — Deploy from Kubernetes YAML
  podman network ls/create       — Network management
  podman volume ls/create        — Volume management
  podman system prune/df         — Disk and cleanup
  podman login/logout            — Registry authentication
  podman stats                   — Live resource usage
  podman top                     — Processes in container
  podman healthcheck run         — Execute container healthcheck

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help

commands.podman generate kube webapp:
# Save this file and use it to deploy with 'podman play kube'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  labels:
    app: webapp
  name: webapp
spec:
  containers:
  - image: docker.io/library/nginx:alpine
    name: web
    ports:
    - containerPort: 80
      hostPort: 8080
  - image: docker.io/library/redis:7-alpine
    name: cache
